verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time card capture and spend visibility (receipts/memos filled the moment a card is swiped), instant virtual cards with per-vendor limits giving 'real-time visibility into SaaS spend', personalized notification workflows by spend amount/team role, and an API/webhooks/MCP layer (transactions:read scope, 'Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter') enabling live querying by team, category, and merchant. Independent probes confirm the transactions API, MCP server, and OpenAPI schema are live and functional, not just claimed. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) case study confirming same-day spend visibility in production use, and a dedicated dashboard view broken out explicitly by team/category/merchant beyond inferred capability.
